title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm wingspan · black base with the red hat and white trim on top · hangs from a tiny hole in the pom-pom, shown as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm wing tip to wing tip (your pick). The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v8: what changed, what to check
notes: v8: the bumpy edge is gone; outlines are smooth again. Instead the top of the white brim and pom-pom has a soft random texture: small tufts about 0.5 mm across, rising up to 0.4 mm, covering about half the surface. Zoom in on the hat and orbit to catch the light. Only the white rises above the red, so there are no extra colour changes. For a finer texture, print the top 1 mm at 0.1 mm layers (Bambu Studio: height range modifier from 2.0 mm up). The pom-pom is back to 4 mm with 1.4 mm around the 1.2 mm hole.
